deadlines.text: NSFAS: applications for 2027 funding close at 23:59.

after.text: Save your reference number, then follow your status in the tracker on myNSFAS.
You have 30 working days to answer any request for more information.
If your application is unsuccessful, myNSFAS shows the reason, and you can appeal within the appeal window.
If NSFAS finds you eligible, your funding is confirmed once you register at a public university or TVET college.

items: Your South African ID or birth certificate (a smart ID card: both sides)
The NSFAS 2027 consent form, signed by hand in black ink by you and by every parent, legal guardian or spouse on your application
If you're 34 or younger: the NSFAS declaration form, which confirms your parent or guardian details
If a parent, legal guardian or spouse earns an income: payslips for the last three months, a UIF statement, or an affidavit if the income is informal
If someone in your household gets a SASSA grant: nothing extra, because NSFAS checks with SASSA
If you have a disability: the disability annexure, completed and signed with a medical practitioner, in one file with your medical report
If you're under 18 and an orphan or a vulnerable child: the orphan or vulnerable child declaration, completed by a social worker
If a parent or guardian has died: a death certificate for each
If your parents are divorced or separated: the divorce decree, or the settlement agreement showing maintenance
If you're married, or a spouse signs for you: your marriage certificate and your spouse's ID
If you live with a legal guardian: proof of legal guardianship issued by a court
If a parent or legal guardian was retrenched: the retrenchment letter from the employer

funding.how: Apply online on myNSFAS or in the official NSFAS app. Create your profile with your South African ID number, your cellphone number and your email address, then fill in your personal and household information, give consent, upload your documents and submit. You can save and finish later.
lines: Where to apply: https://my.nsfas.org.za/

Apply online on myNSFAS or in the official NSFAS app. Create your profile with your South African ID number, your cellphone number and your email address, then fill in your personal and household information, give consent, upload your documents and submit. You can save and finish later.
Applying is free.
Questions: Toll-free 08000 67327, USSD *134*67327#, info@nsfas.org.za

after.text: SMU doesn't process an application with documents missing, and doesn't consider it if they're still missing after two months.
SMU gets more applications than it has places, so meeting the requirements doesn't guarantee admission.
Residence places are limited and given first come, first served: admission doesn't guarantee a room.
MBChB and Diagnostic Radiography: SMU makes provisional offers on final Grade 11 results. Grade 12 results decide: if yours drop below your Grade 11 ones, you rejoin the general pool of applicants.
BDS, Dental Therapy and Oral Hygiene: SMU also makes provisional offers on final Grade 11 results, and Grade 12 results decide.

items: A certified copy of your ID or passport (compulsory)
Your certified Grade 11 end-of-year results if you're in Grade 12, or your National Senior Certificate or IEB certificate if you've finished school
Certified copies of your degree certificates and academic record, if you've studied at SMU or another university
A certified copy of your marriage certificate, if it applies
Proof of payment of the R300 application fee
